scope: revision-53 non-GHG static MATERIAL core using natural RuurloGrass
findings: defmat and deffra use IPO-conditioned implied-DO phosphorus reads; with IPO=0 the natural trailing zero columns are lexical residue rather than normalized Frpo/Pofr values
pofrex and Pofrhuma are parsed and range-checked unconditionally even when IPO=0
matfra uses sparse list-directed assignment that can span physical records
revision-53 subsequently reads and validates all FR/Frca entries for each material, while the MATERIAL block itself does not explicitly initialize unassigned entries

open_dependency.description: legacy meaning of unassigned sparse FR/Frca entries
